cases.title: Inkwell 打印机情景喜剧
cases.prompt_original:
Make a 60-second 16:9 cartoon sitcom episode for people who follow our channel, playing YouTube and Shorts. Use only the names, facts and lines below as given; invent the story, the jokes and an original cast around them, and no real people or existing characters.

A 2D TV-cartoon look: thick dark outlines that wobble slightly, flat colour, big round eyes, noodle arms. Two characters with clearly different voices and one small non-speaking creature. The comedy is banter, pauses and reaction close-ups, not action: they mostly stand or sit and act with face and hands. One palette per place, subtitles with a coloured speaker label on every line, a title card by 15 seconds, a light synthesized score that ducks under the dialogue. End on a card with the series title, the episode name and my end line, held 4 seconds.

Topic: "an office printer that never works"

Must appear, word for word: the line "Have you tried turning it off?"; the name Inkwell

Cast ideas (optional): "a deadpan office manager and a nervous intern"

End line: "Inkwell — printers that print."

风格：

美式手绘二维卡通动画风格。角色与物体造型高度夸张、几何化且简化，具有强烈的夸张表情。画面通篇采用清晰均匀的黑色粗轮廓线勾勒，内部以大面积纯色平涂填充，几乎无体积光影与渐变渲染。整体色彩明快柔和，饱和度适中，空间纵深扁平，背景线条与色块结构简练，呈现鲜明的扁平插画质感。
